name: Initial Consultation (SOAP)
description: Standard SOAP-format clerking for a new patient's first visit
content:
INITIAL CONSULTATION

S — Subjective

Chief Complaint:
[State the patient's main complaint in their own words with duration]

History of Presenting Illness (HPI):
[Onset, Character, Location, Radiation, Association, Timing, Exacerbating/Relieving factors, Severity (SOCRATES)]

Past Medical History:
[Chronic illnesses, surgeries, hospitalizations]

Drug History & Allergies:
[Current medications, known allergies]

Family History:
[Relevant family conditions]

Social History:
[Occupation, smoking, alcohol, exercise, living situation]

Review of Systems:
CVS: / RS: / GIT: / GUS: / MSS: / CNS: / Endo: / Psych:

O — Objective

General Examination:
[Appearance, alertness, distress level, BMI]

Vital Signs:
BP: / HR: / Temp: / RR: / SpO2: / Pain:

Systemic Examination:

SystemFindings
CVS[Heart sounds, murmurs, JVP, peripheral pulses]
RS[Air entry, breath sounds, percussion]
Abdomen[Soft/tender, organomegaly, bowel sounds]
CNS[GCS, pupils, power, tone, reflexes, sensation]
MSS[Joint inspection, ROM, deformities]

A — Assessment

Working Diagnosis:
[Primary diagnosis]

Differential Diagnoses:

P — Plan

Investigations:
[Labs, imaging, special tests ordered]

Treatment:
[Medications, non-pharmacological measures]

Patient Education:
[Counselling points, lifestyle modifications]

Follow-Up:
[When, where, what to watch for]

Disposition: [ ] Discharge   [ ] Admit   [ ] Refer

name: Discharge Summary
content:
DISCHARGE SUMMARY

Date of Admission[Date]
Date of Discharge[Date]
Length of Stay[# days]

Admission Diagnosis

[Primary and secondary diagnoses at admission]

Discharge Diagnosis

[Final confirmed diagnoses (ICD coded)]

Presenting Complaint & History

[Brief summary of why the patient was admitted]

Hospital Course

[Summary of treatment, procedures performed, significant events, complications]

Investigation Summary

InvestigationDateKey Finding

Procedures Performed

[List any surgical or invasive procedures with dates]

Condition at Discharge

[ ] Recovered   [ ] Improved   [ ] Unchanged   [ ] Against Medical Advice

Discharge Medications

MedicationDoseRouteFrequencyDuration

Follow-Up Instructions

  • Clinic Appointment: [Date, Clinic]
  • Investigations before next visit: [If any]
  • Activity restrictions: [If any]
  • Diet: [Special instructions]
  • Wound care: [If applicable]

Red Flags — Return to Hospital If:

  • [Symptom 1]
  • [Symptom 2]
  • [Fever > 38.5°C, uncontrolled pain, bleeding, etc.]

name: Referral Letter
content:
REFERRAL LETTER

To: Dr. ______________ — [Specialty/Hospital]

Dear Colleague,

I would be grateful if you could kindly review the following patient:

Reason for Referral

[Specific reason and question for the specialist]

Clinical Summary

Presenting Complaint:
[Brief summary]

Relevant History:
[PMH, medications, allergies]

Examination Findings:
[Key positive and negative findings]

Investigations Done:
[Relevant results — labs, imaging]

Current Treatment:
[Active medications and management]

Working Diagnosis:
[Current diagnosis or differential]

Urgency

[ ] Routine   [ ] Soon (within 2 weeks)   [ ] Urgent   [ ] Emergency

Thank you for seeing this patient. I look forward to your expert opinion.

Yours sincerely,
